title: FAMILY
location: L02 · FAMILY HOME — LIVING ROOM / KITCHEN / HALLWAY
tod: 06:30 → 07:10 · full morning sun inside the house
logline: Four people, one small flat, and the ordinary choreography of a family that does not yet know it is being remembered.
grade: Warm amber interior (#FFB870) with teal shadow pockets. Saturation +8 vs Scene 1 — the house is the warmest place in the film and must stay that way.

narration.hi: मेरी माँ — घर की वो कड़ी जो कभी ढीली नहीं पड़ती। सबसे पहले उठने वाली, और सबसे आख़िर में बैठने वाली।
narration.en: My mother — the link in this house that never goes slack. First to rise, last to sit.

narration.hi: पापा। हर चीज़ का हिसाब, हर बात में तर्क। उन्हें लगता था दुनिया एक समीकरण है — और वो उसे हल कर चुके हैं।
narration.en: Papa. Every thing accounted for, logic in every sentence. He believed the world was an equation — and that he had already solved it.

narration.hi: आरोही — मुझसे एक क्लास छोटी, पर समझ में तीन साल आगे।
narration.en: Aarohi — one class below me, three years ahead of me in understanding.

narration.hi: और विवान। सातवीं का वो तूफ़ान, जिसे हर सुबह कुछ नया तोड़ना होता था।
narration.en: And Vivaan. The storm of class seven, who had to break something new every morning.

shots.cam: Interior, starts at ceiling height 2.8 m, centred on the living room's back wall
shots.move: Slow crane DOWN to 1.6 m over the full 26 s — one continuous move, no cut.
shots.action: A geography of home assembles itself as we descend: ceiling fan, wall calendar, framed family photo, sofa, dining table, and finally a figure crossing behind.
shots.env: Living room: sofa camera-right, dining table centre, kitchen doorway left, hallway to bedrooms at back. Middle-class Indian home — lived-in, not styled.
shots.light: Hard window light from the left casting long rectangles on the floor; warm bounced fill from the cream walls.
shots.vfx: Dust motes; the fan is OFF (it is winter).
shots.cont: Lock the room's geography for the whole episode (G-02): kitchen door LEFT, corridor BACK, main door RIGHT. Never mirror this.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, behind Maa's right shoulder at 1.2 m
shots.move: Slow push-in 0.25 m/s, ending on her hands, not her face.
shots.action: Rolling dough / stirring a pan, turning a flame down, wiping her hands on her dupatta, lifting a steel tiffin off the shelf.
shots.expr: Not visible — we meet her through her hands first. Deliberate.
shots.env: Kitchen: two-burner stove, steel utensils, tiled backsplash slightly stained near the stove.
shots.light: Window over the sink at frame-right: warm key; steam catches the light.
shots.vfx: Steam, faint flour dust in the light.
shots.cont: Maa wears a deep-teal cotton saree with a mustard border; small bindi; two gold bangles on the right wrist only.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, 70 cm from her face, 3/4 turned toward the doorway
shots.move: Static, 1-px breathing. She turns into the lens from a task.
shots.action: She calls toward the hallway (lips move, no audible words), smiles at whatever she sees off-screen, and points a spatula in mock warning.
shots.expr: Warm, tired, faintly amused. Eyes crease before the mouth — lock this order of expression.
shots.light: Window key on her left cheek; the right side falls into soft shadow, still fully readable.
shots.vo: Silence across the turn — let the face carry it.
shots.cont: Her hair is in a low bun with two loose strands at the temple, identical in every scene.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.45 m, in the hallway looking back toward the main door
shots.move: Static. He walks toward the camera and passes frame-left.
shots.action: Adjusts a shirt cuff, fastens a wristwatch, picks up a slim briefcase, checks it once, sets it down again.
shots.expr: Focused, mildly hurried; a single glance at the mirror with no vanity in it.
shots.env: Hallway with a shoe rack, a mirror, and the main door at the far end.
shots.light: Cool daylight from the door glass against warm hallway tungsten — a two-temperature frame.
shots.vo: Line 2 at 02:38, landing on the wristwatch fastening.
shots.cont: Pita: light-blue formal shirt, dark grey trousers, no jacket indoors, silver watch on the LEFT wrist, trimmed moustache, neat hair with grey at the temples.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.20 m, seated-height at the dining table, looking across at Aarohi
shots.move: Slow 15° arc to the right, keeping her centred.
shots.action: Sits with a textbook open, writing, then looks up sharply toward the hallway, closes the book with one finger inside, and half-rises.
shots.expr: Concentration → alertness → the beginning of a smirk. She is always one beat ahead.
shots.env: Dining table, steel glass, a stack of notebooks, a school bag hooked on the chair.
shots.light: Window light from frame-left, warm; the notebook page is the brightest object in the frame.
shots.cont: Aarohi: long dark hair in a single braid, blue ribbon at the end, 9th-standard uniform (white shirt, navy pinafore, navy sweater-vest).

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.10 m at the hall entrance, low enough to catch the bannister
shots.move: Handheld-lite follow as he runs past; small 20° pan, no whip.
shots.action: Slides down the last three steps, lands badly, recovers with enormous dignity, and runs a toy car along the wall as he goes.
shots.expr: Pure chaos wearing a grin. One sock missing.
shots.env: Stair/hall junction, shoes scattered, a school bag dragging open.
shots.light: Backlit from the door; rim light catches his hair.
shots.vo: Line 4 at 03:34, timed to the landing.
shots.cont: Vivaan: 7th standard, short messy hair, white shirt untucked, navy shorts, one sock, scuffed black shoes.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.60 m, behind and left of Ishaan, down the length of the corridor
shots.move: Static. Ishaan steps into frame and stops; the family continues in soft focus beyond him.
shots.action: Ishaan, freshly showered in a plain white shirt, arrives at the end of the corridor and simply watches his family for two full seconds before anyone notices him.
shots.expr: Unreadable, then a small private smile. This is the shot the finale will echo.
shots.env: Corridor to living room; every family member visible but out of focus.
shots.light: Warm interior; Ishaan in near-silhouette with a bright edge.
shots.vo: Silence. Hold the whole 20 s — this is the film's emotional anchor shot.
shots.cont: MIRROR SHOT: S13-06 must reuse this exact framing with the light inverted to blue.
